avoid: Mavis Staples almost didn’t want to record it, because she thought it sounded just like the Staple Singers’ earlier hit ‘I’ll Take You There’.
Their 1972 hit ‘I’ll Take You There’ opens with a groove from ‘The Liquidator’, a 1969 reggae instrumental by Harry J Allstars.
Mavis Staples said that hearing Dr Martin Luther King preach inspired them: ‘If he can preach this, we can sing it’.
Bob Dylan said their gospel record ‘Uncloudy Day’ was ‘the most mysterious thing I’d ever heard’, and that Mavis Staples’s singing ‘just knocked me out’.
After their first two Stax records made little commercial impact, Al Bell sent them to Alabama to record with the Muscle Shoals Rhythm Section.
